title: OfCourse Optimized
description: This modpack consists of 95% optimization mods, so it can certainly improve your Minecraft Java performance.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73f5addb136380c1b1846607f8a12278ac6304f4.png)
# Features

- 🚀 Massive FPS boost compared to vanilla Minecraft

- ⚡ Faster chunk loading and smoother gameplay

- 🧠 Optimized memory and CPU usage

- 🧩 Lightweight and minimal

- 🎮 Suitable for low-end and mid-range PCs
![Look!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae98cad6cd620572b79c52d5dcbffc686c770ba0.png)
**If your Minecraft is still lagging after using this modpack…
congratulations, your computer is just bad** 😐

## Why did I make this modpack?

**Yes**, I know — there are many optimization modpacks out there with a similar concept.
So why make another one?

The difference is focus.

Most optimization modpacks still include extra features, content mods, or visual changes.
This modpack is different: almost everything inside is pure optimization.

I created this modpack for players who:

_Only care about performance_

_Don’t want gameplay changes_

_Just want Minecraft to run as fast and smooth as possible_

No distractions.
Just optimization — of course.

![Low Budget](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2b8bed715e3254b62c9b2e31431c5b4bad69eba.png)
